The '''Deadon Ice Temples''' were a series of temples<ref name="HR" /> situated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Deadon system/Legends|Deadon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] they were discovered by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Angrail Ryhl]] in what constituted a remarkable find.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deadon Ice Temples were mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
